servinfo.title: Compressor Drive Belt Description (K14C Model)
servinfo.ptxt: The compressor drive belt is a stretch-type belt. It stretches itself to maintain the belt tension. Therefore, a tension pulley, which is used to adjust the belt tension, or components for adjusting the clearance between the crankshaft pulley and the magnet clutch pulley are not necessary. When removing or installing the stretch-type belt, use the special tool to prevent the belt from being damaged.
